ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 3080 Trinity OC

ZT-A30800J-10P

Get Amplified with the ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX™ 30 Series based on the NVIDIA Ampere architecture. Built with enhanced RT Cores and Tensor Cores, new streaming multiprocessors, and superfast GDDR6X memory, the ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 3080 Trinity OC gives rise to amplified gaming with ultra graphics fidelity.

Features: - 2nd Gen Ray Tracing Cores - 3rd Gen Tensor Cores - SPECTRA 2.0 RGB Lighting - IceStorm 2.0 Advanced Cooling - Active Fan Control with FREEZE Fan Stop - Metal Frontplate and RGB LED Backplate - FireStorm Utility (Download HERE) - VR Ready
